thought.text: PostgreSQL ready. Now let me set up Elasticsearch. Let me check the required version.

reasoning_content:
PostgreSQL ready. Now Elasticsearch. The Gemfile uses elasticsearch 8.11.2 gem but compose uses elasticsearch:9.3.2 image. Let me look at how ES is used in config to determine compatible version. Actually the gem is just the client; server can be 9. Let me check the ES config used. But first install Elasticsearch 9 server. Let's check apt approach from elastic. Actually, the compose uses 9.3.2. Let me install that via tarball or apt.

Let me check the ES setup in zammad - what version is required. Let me search.

action.command: grep -rn "elasticsearch" /workspace/config/ /workspace/lib/ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "version|9\.|8\.|url" | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "es_url\|es_index\|ZAMMAD_ES\|ELASTICSEARCH" /workspace/config/*.rb /workspace/config/**/*.rb 2>/dev/null | head -20
